name: Nimba viviparous toad
desc: A critically endangered toad found only in the high grasslands of Nimba at about 1,200 to 1,680 m. It gives birth to live young and does not tolerate disturbed ground.
about: Nimbaphrynoides is a monotypic genus of true toads from highlands in the Mount Nimba region of the West African countries of Guinea, Liberia, and Côte d'Ivoire.
